_how: Every loop in the system, one contract: trigger -> work -> self-check -> card (only if needed) -> feeds. layer runtime = runs on Graham's Mac (n8n, pm2, LM Studio). layer improve = Claude scheduled review in the Marketing project. run = the module runner.js calls; loops without it run elsewhere and are listed so the map and the weekly review see the whole system. status: live | built (needs a Mac step) | new | planned | later. off: true = the runner skips it until there is data (posts, followers, clients).

loops.name: Stats pull
loops.work: Pull IG + FB account and post stats
loops.check: Health check flags a stale or failed run

loops.name: Viral scout
loops.where: n8n Open Frame viral scout + pm2 video-watch
loops.work: Find outlier posts from big creators, watch each one
loops.check: Outlier = 3x creator median

loops.name: Pattern report
loops.work: What the outliers share + hook bank
loops.check: Numbers computed, AI only summarises

loops.name: Trending sounds
loops.work: Sounds from this month's outliers, weighted by how far they beat normal; mood labels; every script gets a sound + backup
loops.check: Original-voice tracks dropped, only real names from the list, old sounds fade
loops.card: This week's sounds (Got it); sound line on each Film this card

loops.name: Weekly ideas
loops.work: Pitch 8 ideas per client from own stats + viral patterns + past yes/pass
loops.check: Banned words, em dash, question opener, past passes, AI judge 3.5/5, one retry

loops.name: Scripts
loops.trigger: Every 5 min, on each idea you said yes to
loops.work: One-take script + caption
loops.check: 75-110 words, rules, full https link, AI judge, one retry
loops.card: Script card on the Studio Reels tab (Filmed it / Change / Pass)

loops.name: Scripts on demand
loops.trigger: New scripts button on openframe.design/studio Reels tab (per type: Open Frame, Personal, Viral in my niche), or Change on a script
loops.work: 3 talking head scripts of that type with LM Studio; viral ones rebuild a format from the pattern report + hook bank
loops.check: 40-100 words, rules, full https link, 'I have ADHD', no b-roll, private copy rules, AI judge, one retry
loops.card: Script cards on the Reels tab

loops.name: Reel drafts
loops.work: Transcribe, edit, cover, caption, queue rows
loops.check: Skips <8s, >3min, <12 words

loops.name: Graphics ideas
loops.work: Pitch a graphic, 3 stills, animate the pick
loops.check: Text overflow, empty render
loops.card: Yes / Pass, then A / B / C

loops.name: Monthly plan
loops.work: Plan next month's posts from learnings + approved ideas backlog
loops.check: Empty slot if no real material

loops.name: Engagement
loops.work: Draft comments on prospect posts, learning from your edits; DM draft when someone is warm
loops.check: 2 sentences, no links/hashtags/pitch, 1 emoji max, sensitive posts skipped, one retry
loops.card: Copy and open (existing Engage cards), warm lead card

loops.name: Pipeline
loops.work: Last week's comments, leads, consults, wins vs the $4k plan; tunes how many comments engage drafts
loops.check: Never drafts more than you send

loops.name: Site + AI search
loops.work: Site check vs last month, 3 rotating ChatGPT prompt checks
loops.check: Diff vs last month, only new problems flagged
loops.card: Site check (Got it), Does ChatGPT name you? (Yes/Pass)

loops.name: AI search answers
loops.work: Answered prompt cards to ai-search.csv
loops.check: Only answered cards

loops.name: Free site check
loops.trigger: Someone fills in the free check form
loops.work: Runs the site check, publishes the report, Hub emails it with the booking link and adds them to Leads
loops.check: Report must have read the site; fixed email template, no AI
loops.card: New lead (Got it), only if it fails: couldn't check

loops.name: Proposals
loops.trigger: A lead moves to consult held
loops.work: Picks the plan from call notes, builds the proposal page with rate card prices
loops.check: Plan must exist, prices only from the rate card, copy rules, one retry

loops.name: Onboarding
loops.work: Adds the client everywhere, then day 0/3/7/14/30/60/90 steps from the playbook
loops.check: Emails: rules, under 140 words, no we/our, one retry
loops.card: Email cards (Send / Edit) and Got it reminders

loops.name: Directories
loops.work: 2 free listings per client with a ready-to-paste description
loops.check: Rules, 120-600 characters

loops.name: Local events
loops.work: Reads event feeds, scores fit, best 3
loops.check: Score 4+/5; feeds that fail 3 times switch off

loops.name: Google Business posts
loops.work: Google Business update from the best post or an approved idea
loops.check: Rules, 200-800 characters

loops.name: Template saver
loops.work: Month's best post becomes a template candidate
loops.check: Score 10+ and not saved before

loops.name: Money + goal bar
loops.work: Invoices, paid? cards, income vs the $4k goal, goal bar image
loops.check: Owned by the business ops thread

loops.name: Proof posts
loops.work: A client's numbers jump 20%+ -> case study carousel idea
loops.check: Only real numbers, rules

loops.name: Warm-up DMs
loops.work: People who show up 2+ times get a soft DM draft
loops.check: Rules, no pitch, no link

loops.name: Client health
loops.work: Results trend, overdue approvals, quiet time -> health score
loops.check: Card only under 70/100

loops.name: Trend Reels
loops.work: Fresh 5x+ outlier -> fast rebuild idea
loops.check: Rules, hook shape

loops.name: Poster
loops.work: Post approved, due rows to IG + FB
loops.check: Meta response, failed -> urgent card

loops.name: Comment + DM replies
loops.work: Reply in voice ~5 min later
loops.check: No I/we, no prices, upset -> flag

loops.name: Brand deals scout
loops.work: Find brands similar creators work with, then contacts
loops.check: AI labels fit, caption markers

loops.name: Key account radar
loops.trigger: A key account (Targets tab) commented or DMed this week
loops.work: Local AI drafts a follow-up DM that continues the conversation
loops.check: Rules (no pitch, no link, no banned words); one card per account per week
loops.card: Key account reached out: DM draft (Got it)

loops.name: Mission-driven spotlight
loops.trigger: Weekly; a key account with 2+ recent posts not featured yet
loops.work: Carousel draft from their own posts + DM asking their OK
loops.check: Rules; caption must tag them; facts only from their posts
loops.card: Spotlight them? (Yes/Change/Pass), then Ask before featuring

loops.name: Brand + UGC deals
loops.trigger: Brands tab rows (brand scout + contact finder) at fit high/medium with an email or creator program
loops.work: Picks UGC or sponsored, drafts a pitch with 3 video ideas linking the UGC page
loops.check: Rules; no prices or follower counts; must link the UGC page
loops.card: Send pitch (email card) or Apply here; one follow-up after 7 days

loops.name: Approvals sync
loops.where: Hub (hub/Code.gs syncApprovals_, inside the hourly healthCheck trigger)
loops.work: One Approvals row per Queue decision (posts, Reels, newsletters, topics) for Studio; answers flow both ways between the Queue and the Approvals tab
loops.check: Kind from approval-items.md only, client_ok rules enforced, history rows left out
loops.card: none (the Approvals rows are the cards Studio will show)

loops.name: Health check
loops.work: Workflow failures, token expiry, Mac heartbeat
loops.check: Is the check itself stale

loops.name: Monthly report
loops.work: Branded report + learnings file per client
loops.check: Numbers only from rows

loops.name: Weekly improvement review
loops.work: Read every loop's runs, yes/pass rates and post results, write lessons, fix prompts and rules
loops.check: Only changes loops/ prompts, lessons, rules; opens a PR

loops.name: Mac keeper
loops.work: Restarts stopped pm2 apps, n8n and ngrok; starts the LM Studio server and loads the model; pulls the repo; deploys hub/Code.gs when it changes
loops.check: Each check reports ok / fixing / fail to the Hub 'Mac status' tab
loops.card: Status lights on the Reels tab; Heads up card + one email when something stays down 10 min
